<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<title>Opportunity shortlist</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:light dark;--bg:#fff;--ink:#10131a;--ink2:#5a6372;--rule:#e5e8ec;--soft:#f6f7f9;--accent:#2545c8;--amber:#8f5508;--amberbg:#fdf3e1;--red:#c0392b;--green:#1b7f5a}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0d0f13;--ink:#e8eaee;--ink2:#8a93a0;--rule:#23272e;--soft:#14171c;--accent:#6a8cff;--amber:#e8b03e;--amberbg:#2a2113;--red:#ff8478;--green:#4fd39a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.65 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
main{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 36px 72px}
h1{font-size:26px;line-height:1.25;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 16px;margin:0 0 32px}
.banner{background:var(--amberbg);border-left:4px solid var(--amber);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;margin:8px 0 24px;font-size:14px}
a{color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:2px}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}
button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent);background:none;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:auto}
details.acc{background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:16px;border-left:4px solid var(--accent)}details.acc.critical{border-left-color:var(--red)}
details.acc>summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto;gap:8px 18px;align-items:center;padding:22px 26px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
details.acc>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.n{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink2)}.t{font-weight:600;font-size:17px;line-height:1.35}.g{grid-column:2;color:var(--ink2);font-size:14px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;grid-row:1;grid-column:3}.caret{transition:transform .15s;color:var(--ink2);margin-left:4px}details[open]>summary .caret{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.chip{font-size:12px;line-height:1;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.fit-Strong{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);font-weight:600}.fit-Partial{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber);font-weight:600}.fit-Weak{border-color:var(--ink2);color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600}.fit-Conflicts{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);font-weight:600}.flag{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
.body{padding:6px 26px 28px 76px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px 64px}
@media (min-width:960px){.body{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.k{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);margin:22px 0 6px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.body p{margin:0}.body ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px}.body li{margin-bottom:8px}
.meta{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}.meta span+span:before{content:" \00b7 "}
.decide{margin-top:22px;font-weight:600}.acts{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}.acts a{font-size:13px;padding:7px 14px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none}
details.fold{background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 26px;margin-bottom:16px}details.fold>summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}details.fold ul{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:20px;font-size:14px}details.fold li{margin-bottom:12px}details.fold p{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.tiles{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:28px}.tile{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)}.tile b{color:var(--ink);font-size:16px;margin-left:6px}
.foot{color:var(--ink2);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:28px}.err{color:var(--red)}
@media (max-width:640px){main{padding:24px 16px 48px}h1{font-size:21px}details.acc>summary{grid-template-columns:22px 1fr;padding:18px 18px}.chips{grid-column:2;grid-row:auto}.g{grid-column:2}.body{padding:4px 18px 22px 18px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>
<script id="maskin-sources" type="application/json">{"main":{"type":"bet","filters":{"status":"opportunity"}}}</script></head><body><main id="root"></main>
<script id="results-data" type="application/json">
{
 "headline": "Which opportunities should we act on now?",
 "banner": "",
 "considered": "No ranking yet. The weekly discovery briefing writes the first one.",
 "title": "Ranked by fit",
 "asOf": "",
 "items": [],
 "aside": [],
 "monitor": [],
 "recent": [],
 "tiles": [{"k": "Opportunity bets open", "src": "main"}],
 "foot": "Replaced every week by the weekly discovery briefing."
}
</script>
<script>(function(){
var D;function el(t,c,x){var e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e}
function link(t,u){var a=el('a',null,t);a.href=u;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';return a}
function field(b,k,v){if(!v)return;var w=el('div');w.appendChild(el('div','k',k));w.appendChild(el('p',null,v));b.appendChild(w)}
function list(b,k,a,links){if(!a||!a.length)return;var w=el('div');w.appendChild(el('div','k',k));var u=el('ul');a.forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');if(links)li.appendChild(link(x.t,x.u));else li.textContent=x;u.appendChild(li)});w.appendChild(u);b.appendChild(w)}
function render(){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='';
 var all=(D.items||[]);var items=all.filter(function(i){return i.attention!=='Monitor'}).slice(0,7);var mon=all.filter(function(i){return i.attention==='Monitor'});
 var hd=el('div','head');hd.appendChild(el('h1',null,D.headline));
 hd.appendChild(el('span','chip',items.length+' shown'));
 if(D.aside&&D.aside.length)hd.appendChild(el('span','chip',D.aside.length+' set aside'));
 if(items.length){var bt=el('button',null,'Expand all');bt.type='button';bt.onclick=function(){var ds=r.querySelectorAll('details.acc');var open=bt.textContent==='Expand all';ds.forEach(function(d){d.open=open});bt.textContent=open?'Collapse all':'Expand all'};hd.appendChild(bt)}
 r.appendChild(hd);
 if(D.banner)r.appendChild(el('p','banner',D.banner));
 if(!items.length){var q=el('div','fold');q.appendChild(el('b',null,'Nothing is ranked yet.'));r.appendChild(q)}
 items.forEach(function(i){var d=el('details','acc'+(i.attention==='Critical'?' critical':''));d.id='brief-'+i.rank;
  var s=el('summary');s.appendChild(el('span','n',String(i.rank)));s.appendChild(el('span','t',i.title));
  var c=el('span','chips');var fc=el('span','chip fit-'+i.fit.level,i.fit.level);fc.title='Fit with the strategy. Rated by '+i.fit.by;c.appendChild(fc);
  if(/^own read/i.test(i.fit.by||'')){var ow=el('span','chip','◐ Own read');ow.title='Nobody has rated this yet';c.appendChild(ow)}
  if(i.oneVoice)c.appendChild(el('span','chip flag','1 voice'));else if(i.flag)c.appendChild(el('span','chip flag',i.flag));c.appendChild(el('span','caret','▸'));s.appendChild(c);
  s.appendChild(el('span','g',i.gist));d.appendChild(s);
  var b=el('div','body');
  var L=el('div');field(L,'What we found',i.found);field(L,'Why it matters',i.why);field(L,'Next step',i.next);
  if(i.decision)L.appendChild(el('div','decide',i.decision));
  if(i.actions&&i.actions.length){var a=el('div','acts');i.actions.forEach(function(x){a.appendChild(link(x.t,x.u))});L.appendChild(a)}
  b.appendChild(L);
  var R=el('div');list(R,'Evidence ('+i.voices+')',i.evidence,true);list(R,'Against',i.against,false);list(R,'Not known yet',i.unknown,false);b.appendChild(R);
  var m=el('div','meta');[i.fit.line,'Confidence: '+String(i.confidence||'').split('.')[0],i.when,i.reviewers&&('Review: '+i.reviewers)].forEach(function(x){if(x)m.appendChild(el('span',null,x))});b.appendChild(m);
  d.appendChild(b);r.appendChild(d)});
 if(mon.length){var dm=el('details','fold');dm.open=true;dm.appendChild(el('summary',null,'Monitoring ('+mon.length+')'));var mu=el('ul');mon.forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');var a0=(x.actions&&x.actions[0])?x.actions[0].u:null;li.appendChild(a0?link(x.title,a0):document.createTextNode(x.title));li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(': '+x.gist));mu.appendChild(li)});dm.appendChild(mu);r.appendChild(dm)}
 if(D.aside&&D.aside.length){var da=el('details','fold');da.appendChild(el('summary',null,'Set aside ('+D.aside.length+')'));var au=el('ul');D.aside.forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');li.appendChild(link(x.t,x.u));au.appendChild(li)});da.appendChild(au);r.appendChild(da)}
 if(D.fold){var fd=el('details','fold');fd.appendChild(el('summary',null,D.fold.title));var fu=el('ul');D.fold.lines.forEach(function(x){fu.appendChild(el('li',null,x))});fd.appendChild(fu);r.appendChild(fd)}
 if(D.strategy||D.considered){var bs=el('details','fold');bs.appendChild(el('summary',null,'How this was judged'));
  if(D.considered)bs.appendChild(el('p',null,D.considered));
  if(D.strategy){var sp=el('p',null,D.strategy.t+' ');var L2=D.strategy.links;L2.forEach(function(l,i){sp.appendChild(link(l.t,l.u));sp.appendChild(document.createTextNode(i<L2.length-2?', ':i===L2.length-2?' and ':'.'))});bs.appendChild(sp)}
  r.appendChild(bs)}
 if(D.tiles&&D.tiles.length){var g=el('div','tiles');D.tiles.forEach(function(t){var dd=el('div','tile');dd.appendChild(document.createTextNode(t.k));var v=el('b',null,'...');dd.appendChild(v);g.appendChild(dd);
  maskin.query(t.src).then(function(q){v.textContent=String(q.total.count)}).catch(function(e){v.textContent='Could not load';v.className='err';v.title=e&&e.message?e.message:''})});r.appendChild(g)}
 r.appendChild(el('p','foot',D.foot||''))}
try{D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('results-data').textContent);render()}catch(e){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='The page could not load. Try again.';r.className='err'}
})();</script></body></html>
